sources.title: GitHub - google-deepmind/gemma: Gemma open-weight LLM library, from ...
sources.snippet: Gemma is a family of open-weights Large Language Model (LLM) by Google DeepMind, based on Gemini research and technology. This repository contains the implementation of the gemma PyPI package. A JAX library to use and fine-tune Gemma. For examples and use cases, see our documentation. Please report issues and feedback in our GitHub.

sources.title: Gemma — Google DeepMind
sources.snippet: Gemma is a collection of lightweight, open models built from the same technology that powers our Gemini models.

sources.title: GitHub - King-Rafat/S2S_B
sources.snippet: Bangla Speech to Speech (Q-Former + Gemma + Headless VITS) Architecture skeleton for a Bangla speech to speech model that does NOT require codec token training. The trick is to bridge a frozen audio encoder to Gemma with a Q-Former, and condition a community Bangla VITS (with its text encoder removed) on Gemma's hidden states.
